concept.title: Arts, crafts and needlework
concept.shortdesc: Groups, classes and workshops where people make things by hand, including knitting and sewing, general crafts, drawing and painting.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Groups and sessions for knitting, crocheting, sewing and similar needlework, including learning the skill or socialising while doing it.
: Sessions, clubs and workshops where people make things by hand, covering general arts and crafts, jewellery making, woodworking and other craft activities.
: Taking part in drawing, painting and other art sessions, whether as a class, a relaxed group or an art therapy session.
